horn_rule: Images with visible horns are flux_state, even if filename does not mention horns.

assets.visual_context_rule: Classify by image context, not by filename. Any image showing horns is a flux_state reference.

Indalwin.instruction: Indalwin is the representation of Michael/user-self in this visual set. Preserve identity direction; do not treat as a generic fantasy character or stock model.

Rolzen.instruction: Rolzen is the character/model reference. Preserve his size, dangerous grace, combat force, bond posture, and Flux transformation language.

model_attachment_use.use: visual identity/context reference for local offline reconstruction and image-consistency guidance
